0022600039.text: The Utah Jazz (1-10, 15th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (8-3, 5th in the West) in a regular season Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, with Utah on a nine-game losing streak and 0-5 on the road. Utah will be without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Lauri Markkanen (hand fracture), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost 1-3, including a 140-106 defeat in Houston on April 3, 2026.
